additionalProperties.description: Difficulty levels 1-4 for [obstacles, start chase, miss guards, speed].

stages.description: Compact stages: name to knobs [obstacles, chase, miss, speed], levels 1-4. Order is play order. Details come from stageDefaults plus stageOverrides.

knobLevels.description: Central level tables for the four difficulty knobs. Stages pick one level (1-4) per knob.

obstacles.description: Common-tier spawn rate per 100m for obstacle levels 1-4.

chaseCount.description: Start-line yeti count for chase levels 1-4.

chaseSpeedPercent.description: Start-yeti and penalty-wolf chase speed, percent of stage top, for chase levels 1-4.

missGatePercent.description: Share of gates guarded by penalty wolves for miss levels 1-4.

speed.description: Player top speed km/h for speed levels 1-4.

gateSpacing.description: Gate geometry as percent of stage top speed, so reaction time survives higher speeds.

itemTiers.description: Rarity tier of each Arcade object. Per-stage tierRates set the default spawn rate; itemRates overrides single objects.

campaignVersion.description: Increment after major stage changes to archive incomparable records.

startLineSideOffsetMetres.description: Clear lane between waiting yetis and the centre of the start.

startLineRowOffsetMetres.description: Spacing between additional pairs of waiting yetis.

startLineDownhillOffsetMetres.description: Waiting location below the start line.

wakeSeconds.description: Visible reaction before waiting yetis begin chasing.

startStage.description: 1-based stage to begin at. Later starts are practice and do not overwrite records.

autoStart.description: Enter configured start stage on load/reset without skiing into the Arcade entrance.

stageDefaults.description: Base verbose fields for compact stages; stageOverrides replace per key.
